_README: Hand-written replacements for prompts whose Python version names an API or
type with no mechanical equivalent in the target language. port_prompts.py
flags these; this file resolves them.
- a language key ('java'/'cpp'/'c') gives replacement prompt text.
- listing an id under '_no_change_needed' means it was read and the
automatic port is correct; the flag was a false positive on a bare word
The goal is that the target-language prompt asks for the SAME smell with
idiomatic target-language machinery. Changing the smell would make the
languages incomparable, which is the one thing this phase must not do.
